children: The Trump Administration on Thursday picked eight projects under a previously announced aid program to expand domestic fertilizer production, the US Department of Agriculture said in a statement on Thursday.
The total projects represent over $1.34 billion in proposed investment, including approximately $573 million in proposed USDA funding, the statement said.
